tagline: A perfectly preserved Bosphorus village with waterfront cafés, wooden yalıs (mansions), and a charm that feels entirely separate from the rest of Istanbul.

items.name: Yeniköy İskelesi Cafés
items.description: Cafés right at the waterfront and ferry landing with views of the Asian shore. A classic Bosphorus village café experience.
items.tip: The waterfront fills up fast on Sunday mornings. Arrive early and stay long — there's nothing to rush for in Yeniköy.

items.name: Yeniköy Balık Restoranları
items.description: Several fish restaurants on the waterfront serving fresh Bosphorus catch. Excellent quality in an unbeatable setting.

items.name: Yeniköy Pastanesi
items.description: A historic local pastry shop that has served the village for decades. Simple, good, and completely unpretentious.

items.name: Yeniköy Waterfront Walk
items.description: A beautiful promenade under plane trees along the Bosphorus. Walk north to Tarabya or south toward İstinye for a longer route.

items.name: Yalı Architecture
items.description: Yeniköy has some of the finest surviving wooden Bosphorus mansions (yalıs) in Istanbul. Walk the shore road to admire them.

tips: Yeniköy is best reached by the Bosphorus bus route from Beşiktaş, or by ferry from Eminönü (Bosphorus line).
Combine with İstinye (south) and Tarabya (north) for a full Bosphorus village day.
The village is best on weekday mornings — genuinely peaceful and local-feeling.
One of the few upper Bosphorus villages where daily life continues largely unchanged.
